visualMaster.reviewMode: direct full-page visual review + reverse omission audit
visualMaster.rule: The actual user-provided P08 page image is the page-specific authority. P01/P02/P03 are rendering-family anchors only, not layout templates.

reviewCompleteness.reason: Representative center closure passed owner art acceptance, true-alpha QA, live Figma placement and cross-page calibration; remaining P08 modules were then assembled using accepted reuse, native text and deterministic barcode production and passed fresh full-page screenshot review.

threeSecondReadOrder: centered tropical chapel closure ecology with SHOGO & SHIORI / 2026.10.24
upper-left vertical Rurubu/WEDDING tropical brand ecology

visualAuthority.firstImpression: A deliberately sparse premium magazine back cover on warm cream paper. Small authored destination/wedding ecologies punctuate a very large quiet field; it is not a dense thank-you page or a second cover.
visualAuthority.signatureMove: Massive intentional negative space separates three small editorial anchors: upper-left vertical brand spine, compact central tropical chapel closure, and bottom-right barcode/meta block.

pageSpec.geometryRule: Preserve relationships and sparse-space ratios from the Visual Master. Minor micro-placement is flexible, but moving modules into the quiet field or enlarging them enough to destroy the sparse back-cover read is a failure.

backgroundSystem.visualCharacter: clean near-white warm cream paper with extremely subtle print/paper softness; no scenic full-page background

majorObjects.role: compact vertical Rurubu/WEDDING tropical logo cluster
small seaside chapel + aqua shore + palms + tropical floral/ribbon ecology with fixed names/date
bottom-right issue line, pink heart, barcode bars and exact digits
majorObjects.implementation: deterministic editorial barcode bars from canonical digits; no EAN-13 checksum substitution

quietZones.rule: Keep visually empty; do not add headings, photos, stickers, maps or filler decoration.
Preserve as deliberate back-cover breathing room.

relationalConstraints: Center closure remains compact and isolated; it must not grow into a hero occupying the page.
Upper-left brand/meta stays edge-oriented and vertically composed.
Barcode/meta stays clearly separated at bottom-right with ample cream margin.
Page number 08 stays isolated at bottom-left.
No decorative connector lines or flowchart relationships between the three anchors.
The negative space itself is a primary composition element and must not be filled.

allowed: Within P08_CENTER_CLOSURE_ECOLOGY, chapel/palms/flowers/ribbon overlap as one authored group.
Within P08_LEFT_SPINE_BRAND_ECOLOGY, logo/title/tropical accents may overlap as one authored group.

photoPolicy.rule: P08 contains no real-photo slot. Do not invent one and do not use a page crop as a decorative proxy.

displayModuleClassification.rule: Fixed visible copy may be bundled where the Visual Master treats it as one authored object. Barcode digits are always QA-checked against canonical metadata.

groupedEcologyPlan.scaleOutRule: Resolved. No additional P08 ImageGen is required.

confirmed: small pink heart in left spine meta
small pink heart in bottom-right issue meta
no hidden thank-you panel or additional repeated content module

transportEvidence.method: compact 160x133 RGBA transport derivative, 1000-character chunk persistence in temporary hidden Figma nodes, exact 24208-character reassembly, 18155-byte decode, PNG signature check, figma.createImage, temporary-node cleanup

barcodeModuleRule.hardReject: Any visible barcode digits other than 2026102400000.
barcodeModuleRule.deterministicRule: Do not substitute an EAN-13 checksum digit. Use a deterministic barcode representation that preserves the exact visible canonical digits.

systemicPreproductionGates.purpleDriftRule: #7e08f9 and nearby saturated purple must not become a dominant fill/background color without owner approval

hardExecutionRejects: crop from P08.png used as active production asset
center ecology enlarged enough to destroy sparse back-cover hierarchy
binary alpha accepted solely because outside transparency exists
duplicate ImageGen of an accepted owner-approved module to solve a transport/upload failure

remainingExecutionDebt: Git binary sync for P08 production PNG when a binary-capable path is available
optional stable Drive copy of full-page screenshot when a Figma screenshot file-reference bridge is available
